_about: v44 (AI plan Step 23): the report scheduler. A schedule makes the report of the last COMPLETE week / month / quarter before its run date (never a rolling window), so consecutive reports never overlap and 'Since your last report' can compare them. tick_seconds: how often due schedules are looked for. data_grace_days: a run waits this long for the data to reach the end of the period; after that it is skipped (reason data_not_ready) - never a report with a half period. max_late_hours: a run that is later than this (the server was off) is skipped (reason missed); when several runs were missed only the latest is made. Validate with: python tools/check_report_blocks.py
